sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Mu Xiaokui, Young Mistress of the Order (沐小葵) is a story encounter in Village of Lu, found at Village of Lu, with Yu Yao and Tie Gui. Beating it yields Wild Oriole Sword.

sections.title: Where to Find the Mu Xiaokui, Young Mistress of the Order (沐小葵)
sections.content:
Location: Village of Lu, with Yu Yao and Tie Gui.

Appears in: Village of Lu.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Mu Xiaokui, Young Mistress of the Order (沐小葵)
sections.content:
What works

  • Learn her combination strings before countering; the optional ribbon objectives pay extra.
  • She fights alongside Yu Yao and Tie Gui, so the arena stays crowded.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 21 of 60 in the progression order, in Village of Lu. Before it: Dusk, the Puppeteer. After it: Acolyte Yanru. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
